'''Tarkhan''' was a title used by the [[kolkpravis]], the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species']] [[Army/Legends|army]]. The title was held by the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] that [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] a kolkpravis [[horde]], which consisted of 100 [[kamen]]&mdash;groups of two to forty Kaleesh [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].<ref name="GaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of tarkhan was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GaW" />
